direction.premise: A stolen newspaper becomes a fistfight on the roofs of its own printed city. Every strike rewrites the page.
direction.composition: Full-bleed oblique 3D rooftop surrounded by descending city blocks. Hero red coat anchors the pale field; portrait HUD and thumb controls occupy edges.
direction.shapeLanguage: Angular hood, long ivory nib mask and triangular red cape. Crooked rectangular captions and sharp-cut buildings use thick ink outlines.
direction.surfaceAndMaterial: Three-value toon lighting, faceted skin, printed window strips and restrained halftone dots beneath a paper-grain overlay.
direction.paletteLogic: Warm cream paper dominates; blue-grey architecture recedes; black ink provides contours and shadows; vermilion belongs to protagonist and danger.
direction.typography: Condensed heavy comic masthead and bold utility captions, with italic serif narration. No rounded dashboard font or pill navigation.
direction.signature: A red nib-masked courier tears through multiple ink gang members; the perspective roof receives ink marks and a crooked onomatopoeia interrupts the print.
direction.distinction: Arena Shift uses fantasy arena volumes; Perigee uses sparse flat orbital diagrams; Cantica Glass uses church manuscripts. This product instead prints a dense oblique city behind a skewed newspaper masthead and real skeletal comic combat.

production.renderer: App-local Three.js WebGL2 renders real 3D perspective and skinning; DOM provides crisp comic captions and controls. Offline engine is bundled, not loaded from a CDN.
production.focalAsset: Original courier built from authored tapered cloth rings, a nib mask, hood, eye slashes and cape in asset-forge/author.py. A committed eight-bone skinned mesh supports named clips without separate floating limbs.

motion.character: Quick springy courier locomotion versus heavy telegraphed ink enemies. Cape rotation trails body twists and dash produces planar slash rings.
motion.action: Press the strike control near an enemy or dash through a cluster to restore the stolen print and increase the combo.
motion.anticipation: Enemies draw red floor rings for 0.7 to 1 second before contact; the courier shoulder winds back at the start of the Attack clip.
motion.response: Strike immediately plays the arm clip and expanding ink arc. Contact applies damage, recoil, a short hit-stop and a red print burst.
motion.followThrough: The arm returns across 0.38 seconds, burst chips settle, defeated enemies leave floor ink and surviving enemies stagger.
motion.interruption: Cooldown rejects repeated actions without queue debt. Pointer cancellation clears the stick, hidden tabs pause simulation and pause removes active input.
motion.reducedMotion: Camera shake and hit-stop are omitted; attack rings, animations, damage and captions retain all gameplay meaning.

evidence.expectedChange: Opening the first print reveals the health bar and two thumb action controls while the first ink gang wave enters the volume-lit rooftop.
